info.search_setup: We prepare your site for Google and the other search engines: a title and a description for each page, information about your business in a format Google understands, the site map and the reading instructions for search engines. We register your site in Google Search Console, which shows how it is found. We also add a file that presents your business to artificial intelligence assistants.
info.legal: Every site must say who publishes it and what it does with its visitors' data. We set these pages up from the information you give us; you read them over and approve them, as you remain responsible for them.
info.editor: You publish news or change your opening hours whenever you like, without waiting for us. We set up an editing tool connected to your site and show you how to use it. The rest of your pages stays in our hands. If you already have an editing tool, we take it over when possible; taking it over and moving your content are quoted separately. This plan is subscribed for 12-month periods.
info.news: An up-to-date news section shows visitors that your business is alive: latest work, upcoming concerts, new season. You publish there yourself, from your editing space.

domain.label: Managing your domain name
domain.hint: For example {domain}: we register it and renew it for you.
domain.info: The domain name is your site's address, like {domain}. We register it, renew it and pay its fees: you have nothing to keep track of. It belongs to you from day one. This option is subscribed for 12-month periods.

swiss_hosting.label: Website hosted in Switzerland
swiss_hosting.hint: Your data stays on a server located in Switzerland.
swiss_hosting.info: Your site and its data stay on a server located in Switzerland. Once active, Swiss hosting stays part of your subscription.

email.label: An email address in your own name
email.hint: For example contact@{domain}, instead of a free address.
email.info: An address in your own name, like contact@{domain}, shows your customers they are writing to your business. We open the mailbox and pay its fees. This option is subscribed for 12-month periods.

mailboxes.label: Extra mailboxes
mailboxes.hint: One more mailbox per person or use, for example office@{domain}, with its own password.
mailboxes.count: {count, plural, =0 {No extra mailbox} one {# extra mailbox} other {# extra mailboxes}}
mailboxes.info: When several of you work together, or for an association's board, everyone can have their own mailbox in your name, with its own password. These mailboxes are subscribed for 12-month periods; you can remove them at the end of a period.

redirects.label: Forwarding addresses (up to 5)
redirects.hint: Up to 5 addresses forwarding to an existing mailbox, for example invoices@{domain}.
redirects.info: A forwarding address has no mailbox: messages sent to invoices@{domain} land in a mailbox you already have. These addresses are subscribed for 12-month periods; you can remove them at the end of a period.

contact_form.label: A contact form
contact_form.hint: Visitors write to you from your site, and their messages land in your inbox.
contact_form.info: Without this option, a button on your site opens your visitor's email app, and they write to you from their own address. With it, visitors write to you straight from your site, at any hour: each message goes to your inbox, and we keep no copy. An on-screen message confirms it was sent, and a short note under the form explains what happens to the data.

booking.label: Online booking
booking.hint: Your customers book a slot in your Google calendar, straight from your site.
booking.info: Your customers see your free slots and book at any hour, without calling you; they don't need a Google account. You create your booking page in Google Calendar following our guidance, then we add it to your site. Google sends the confirmation and the reminders. You need a Google account, and some Google features require a paid Google subscription, which is not included.

reviews.label: Your customers' reviews on your site
reviews.hint: A selection of your customers' reviews, with their date, updated regularly.
reviews.info: Other customers' reviews reassure a visitor who hesitates to contact you. Regularly, we pick the best reviews, from your Google listing or testimonials you have received, and copy them onto your site with their date. In France, the law requires saying whether reviews are checked and why some are not published: we add that notice.

english.label: Your site in English
english.hint: A complete English version of your site, kept up to date with its main version.
english.info: An English version lets visitors who don't read your site's main language understand you and get in touch. We translate all your pages ourselves, add a language switcher, and translate your changes too without counting them twice. For another language, or a translation by a professional translator, we make you a separate quote. This option is subscribed for 12-month periods.

news.label: News published for you
news.hint: You email us your news, we publish it in a section of your site.
news.info: An up-to-date news section shows visitors that your business is alive: latest work, upcoming concerts, new season. We create the section, then publish what you email us, at the chosen rhythm. These posts do not count towards your content changes. You can lower the rhythm with one month's notice; stopping altogether happens at the end of a 12-month period.

seo.label: Following your place on Google
seo.hint: We follow how your site shows up on Google for your trade and your town, and we adjust it.
seo.info: Your plan includes the settings to be found on Google; this option keeps them alive over time. At the chosen rhythm, we check how your site shows up for searches like “your trade + your town”, adjust your pages and send you a written report. Your Google Maps listing and directories stay managed by you. We don't promise a specific position on Google. This option is subscribed for 12-month periods.

analytics.label: Visit statistics
analytics.hint: You know how many people visit your site and which pages they read, with a written report.
analytics.info: The figures show whether your site is visited, and which pages interest your visitors. We count visits and the most viewed pages anonymously, with no banner for your visitors to accept, then send you a written report in plain words, at the rhythm you choose. This option is subscribed for 12-month periods.

detailed_analytics.label: Detailed statistics (with a cookie banner)
detailed_analytics.hint: A fuller measurement, with a banner asking for your visitors' consent.
detailed_analytics.info: Detailed statistics also tell you where your visitors come from, which device they read you on, and how many tap “Call”, “Directions” or send your form. They set cookies: the law then requires your visitors' consent, and we add a banner to ask for it. Visitors who decline are not counted in these statistics.

articles.label: AI-assisted articles
articles.hint: We write articles for your site, with the help of artificial intelligence, and publish them in a section of their own.
articles.info: Writing articles regularly takes time. We write them for you with the help of artificial intelligence, from information about your business. Together, we choose where to publish them, in a blog or an articles section, depending on their topic. You choose to read each article before it goes live, or to let us publish it directly. Articles do not count towards your content changes. You can lower the rhythm with one month's notice; stopping altogether happens at the end of a 12-month period.
articles.info_tool: Depending on your editing tool, we can use a specialised service that picks topics from what people search for on Google.

domain_question.legend: Do you already have a domain name?
domain_question.help: It is your site's address, for example {domain}.
domain_question.own_note: You keep your domain name and your current email addresses. If you would like help using them with your new site, we talk it through together and send you a quote.

pages.label: Number of pages
pages.info: A page is, for example, “About”, “Services” or “Pricing”. The homepage is included. The legal notice and the privacy policy are not counted.

updates.label: Changes to your pages
updates.hint: You email us your changes: texts, photos, opening hours. We put them online, with no extra charge for each request. News and articles have their own option.
updates.disabled_hint: Tick the box to choose a rhythm.
updates.hint_self_service: For everything you don't publish yourself: you email us your changes, and we put them online.
updates.info: Once a year, we update your pages, included in your plan. If your information changes more often, choose a rhythm: you email us your changes, and we put them online. A change is one request: you can group several changes in it.

total.label: Your estimate
total.note: Indicative price, confirmed after a first conversation. You can add options at any time. The number of pages and Swiss hosting stay part of your subscription once active. Options marked “1-year commitment” can be removed at the end of each 12-month period, the others with one month's notice (see the <link>terms of sale</link>).
total.question: A question first? <link>Write to us</link>.
total.beyond: Beyond these volumes, we will talk it through and make you a proposal.
